name: create-retry
about: A create that fails for a reason that usually passes (here the built-in Linux runtime did not start) runs once more by itself: the row says Retrying… and goes on, and a second failure is shown. A create that fails for a lasting reason (no disk space) is never retried; when it fails the same way again (same cause, same machine, same image), even after the first row was dismissed, the row offers that cause's fix instead of a plain Try again. A success there clears the count.
